chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: Ken Murray's Hollywood revue
summary: She appeared in Ken Murray's revue in Hollywood.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Okay. If I'm wrong people can check on that in this book by David Meeker. Okay, something else I saw which I don't think I asked you about before is whether you appeared in something called 'Black-outs'?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

No that was out in Hollywood. It was a review that Ken Murray did. I was out there in the review for about ten weeks in 1944. He had a long run out there. Ken Murray at the El Capitan Theater. It was something similar to the "Hell's A-Poppin'" that was done here on Broadway in New York. In fact, later, years later Ken Murray did bring "Blackouts" to New York but it didn't have too much success. It bordered on burlesque. It had a few skits in there and different type acts. He had guests, Hollywood stars in as guests occasionally.
Did you do anything other than sing?
Do you remember what you did?
